title: SB2888 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, permits a person to carry a handgun in a concealed manner; permits a person carrying a handgun in a concealed manner to carry in parks, higher education campuses, and areas posted by local governments in the same manner permitted by handgun carry permit holders. - Amends TCA Section 10-7-504; Section 33-6-413; Section 38-8-116; Title 39; Section 50-1-312; Title 70, Chapter 4, Part 1 and Section 70-5-101.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2020-02-06; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513212433 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/111/Bill/SB2888.pdf (LegiScan doc 2126690))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed), 2020-02-06. Adopted amendments, if any, are not in the text read. Same document text as the crossfiled twin HB 2661. Section 13 repeals the enhanced/concealed handgun carry permit section (39-17-1366); sections 14-28 mostly change cross-references and 'permit holder' wording. Section 2 quote is a fragment because the subdivision is introduced by a conditional clause: 'If a person is cited solely for a first violation of subdivision (a)(1)(A) and the person carries the handgun in a concealed manner following issuance of the citation:'.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)(1)): (A) A person commits an offense who carries, with the intent to go armed, a firearm in an open manner or a club.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)(1)): (B) A person does not violate subdivision (a)(1)(A) by carrying a handgun that the person lawfully possesses in a concealed manner.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)(3)): (A) A law enforcement officer shall not confiscate the person's handgun;
SECTION 13 (TCA 39-17-1366): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1366, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 11 (TCA 39-17-1313(d)): (d) A person transporting, storing, or both transporting and storing a firearm or firearm ammunition in accordance with this section does not violate this section if the firearm or firearm ammunition is observed by another or a security device during the ordinary course of the person securing the firearm or firearm ammunition from observation in or on a motor vehicle.
